name: draft-pipeline
description: Nightly indexer for pre-publication drafts (astgl-articles/substack/YYYY-MM-DD-*) and the processed-moments topic ledger. Lets the MCP answer 'have I drafted/written about X?' before regenerating duplicate content. Published Substack articles continue to be picked up by the existing 6h content-pipeline once they hit astgl.ai.

preExec.description: Scan substack/ draft folders + processed-moments.json, embed chunks via Ollama, upsert into knowledge.db with contentType=draft.

instructions: Review the JSON output: drafts_indexed, ledger_entries, chunks_created.
If drafts_indexed went down unexpectedly, flag it (drafts may have been moved to published/ or the path changed).
If embeddings failed (Ollama down), surface the error rather than silently passing.
